description: Comprehensive codebase analysis in one call. Runs get_component_tree + get_complexity_report + get_context_map + detect_circular_deps and returns a combined report with summary. Use this instead of calling 4 tools separately. Pass the entry file (e.g., App.tsx) and optionally a root path for directory-level scans.

entryFile.description: Absolute path to the entry React component file (e.g., /path/to/App.tsx)

rootPath.description: Root directory for complexity/context/deps scanning. Defaults to the entry file's directory.

name: analyze_codebase
